feeds.name: US Equities Daily Bar Pipeline (NYSE / NASDAQ / AMEX)
feeds.primary_source: Yahoo Finance via the unofficial chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com), end-of-day
feeds.notes: 9 US symbols, all currently listed large caps. The universe is survivorship-biased: delisted and acquired constituents are not present, so results computed over it are optimistically biased.

feeds.name: Canadian Equities Daily Bar Pipeline (TSX)
feeds.primary_source: Yahoo Finance via the unofficial chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com), end-of-day
feeds.notes: 10 TSX symbols, CAD denominated, all currently listed. Also survivorship-biased for the same reason as the US universe. No TMX Datalinx subscription; this platform is not a certified reseller of TMX data.

feeds.name: SEC EDGAR Continuous Regulatory Filings
feeds.primary_source: SEC EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions and companyfacts APIs), public XBRL
feeds.notes: Strict 10 req/s rate-limited ingestion with declared User-Agent.

feeds.name: Bank of Canada Valet & FRED Macro Feed
feeds.primary_source: Bank of Canada Valet REST API (public, free)
feeds.notes: Overnight policy rate, GoC benchmark bond yields, and CAD/USD exchange rate.

universe_note: The universe is 19 currently listed large-cap symbols. It is survivorship-biased: delisted and acquired constituents are absent, so any statistic computed across it is optimistically biased.
